_comment: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and adjust. run_conversion.py reads it; Claude Code driving SKILL.md by hand does not need it.
_base_url_note: Any OpenAI-compatible root whose model accepts image_url parts: NVIDIA NIM, a local llama.cpp/vLLM/Ollama server, or a provider's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
_model_note: Must be a vision model: it reads the page images. Quality is model-bound — a small local VLM will fail the gate on hard pages, and the runner then stops and says where. Confirm the exact id with your provider.
_device_note: x3 (528x792) or x4pro (480x800). The runner cannot ask, so a job it plans takes this. An existing job.json keeps its own.
_figures_note: single: each figure/table on one page, turned 90 degrees when that makes it bigger. double: split over two consecutive pages when that makes it at least 1.25x bigger, or when it avoids turning the figure at no loss of size.
_max_attempts_note: Writes per chunk before the runner stops on it: the first, plus reworks fed the gate's report.
_review_note: Chunks without a text layer are always reviewed (no other gate exists for them). true also reviews chunks the fidelity gate already passed.
